# PADDED-001 — fixture PID whose sections are padded, not written

Proves: the non-triviality floor counts *distinct* words, not characters,
bytes, lines or total words. Identity holds and all four required sections are
present and correctly spelled, so all four section reasons fire and the
identity reason does not — exactly as for
`pid-invalid-empty-sections.md`, which is the point: padding buys nothing an
empty body does not already have.

Each body below is far longer than any real section of this length would need
to be, and each contains exactly one distinct word. A character count, a byte
count, a line count or a total-word count would all accept these. Six distinct
words is the floor precisely because it cannot be reached by repetition.
